column1: # IVONE'S DEATH, WHICH THIS ARCHIVE DID NOT HAVE IN ANY FORM.
# Certificado de Óbito n.º 12893536, Ministério da Saúde, Direcção-Geral da Saúde, Portugal.
# Photographed from the family's own papers and supplied by Derrick, 27 September 2026.
# THE CERTIFYING PHYSICIAN'S NAME AND PROFESSIONAL LICENCE NUMBER ARE ON THE FORM AND ARE NOT
# PUBLISHED HERE. He is a living person and the archive's rule about living people does not
# stop being true because a document is interesting.
*** IVONE MOTA DE FIGUEIREDO, DAUGHTER OF JOAQUIM JÚLIO DE FIGUEIREDO AND LEÓNIA DOS SANTOS MOTA ***
column2: the same two parents the birth assento names, spelt MOTA here and MATA there — see data/ivone-assento-nascimento-1922.tsv, which does not settle it either.
04/03/1922, in the certificate's own boxes. INDEPENDENT CONFIRMATION OF THE BIRTH ASSENTO and a second document against this archive's published 1924.

the box is ticked for divorced, not single and not widowed — sixty-two years after the wedding of 1939 and sixty-five after she left Mozambique. The Portuguese state recorded her to the end as a divorcée, which is what averbamento 2 of her birth entry made her in December 1945.
freguesia de Nossa Senhora da Conceição, concelho de Lourenço Marques — Moçambique. Identical to the assento.

column1: *** RESIDÊNCIA HABITUAL: RUA NOVA DAS MARINHAS 82, GULPILHARES, VILA NOVA DE GAIA, DISTRITO DO PORTO, PORTUGAL ***
column2: she died where she lived. THIS ARCHIVE HAD NO PORTUGUESE ADDRESS FOR HER AT ALL and no indication she had returned to Portugal.
local do óbito is ticked for a private dwelling rather than a hospital or clinic.

column1: the date is March 2010 and the day is NOT legible enough to publish
column2: the boxed digits read as 16 or 17 and this archive will not choose between them by eye. WHAT BOUNDS IT: the certifying physician dated his signature 16/03/2010, and the whole bundle was faxed the same day at 14:38. So the death is on or immediately before 16 March 2010, and she was 88.
the assento de óbito at the Conservatória do Registo Civil for Vila Nova de Gaia, or the averbamento of death that should now sit on the birth entry transcribed above.
FALÊNCIA CARDIO-RESPIRATÓRIA — cardio-respiratory failure. Approximate interval between onset and death: more than one year.
*** DEMÊNCIA *** — dementia, also more than a year, recorded as a contributing condition rather than the direct cause.
NATURAL. The cause was given on clinical grounds, with no autopsy, and the certificate records that a physician had attended her in the seven days before she died.

column1: *** DERRICK TRAVELLED TO PORTUGAL AT HIS MOTHER'S DEATH ***
column2: faxed with this certificate on 16 March 2010 at 14:38 is a DECLARAÇÃO signed at Santa Marinha — a parish of Vila Nova de Gaia, the same concelho — in which a householder declares that he is giving lodging to "o Sr. DERIKE" on his journey to Portugal. An accommodation letter of the kind a consulate asks for.
